tabs.tab1_description:
Garnet gemstone is a stone of valor, the Garnet helps to replenish one's inner strength to overcome one's handicaps and achieve one's goals. The red Garnet stone develops feelings of calm and serenity. It is a grounding stone that helps distance negative feelings. Garnet, the word is derived from the Latin word ‘malum granatum’ which means grain fruit. The term refers to the pomegranate fruit, whose grains have a gleaming color similar to that of the Garnet stone. Garnet usually has a red tint, sometimes with a brown or purple undertone. It is only in natural light that Garnet appears in its original color.

We can nevertheless find garnets with other colors such as green, yellow or orange. From the family of Silicates, the chemical composition of Garnet varies according to its variety and its color. Its hardness ranges from 6 to 7.5 and its density can range from 3.5 to 4.3. Garnet deposits are quite abundant. It is found in magmatic rocks, in pegmatites and especially in rocks in contact with magma. The main Garnet mining countries today are Tanzania, India and Madagascar. Other deposits are found in Russia, Mali, Canada and Brazil. Garnet stone brings joy and strength to live. It generates courage and gives confidence. Its ability to develop self-confidence allows people who wear it to succeed in whatever tasks they undertake.

Garnet is truly one of the most recommended gemstones for its therapeutic healing properties. If you desire complete healing of your feelings, emotions, mind, body, and spirit, Garnet is an excellent gemstone to choose. Garnet's extraordinary heat energy is sufficient to eliminate toxins from the body. Additionally, its red sheen represents blood. It maintains stable blood pressure and circulation. In addition, it keeps the heartbeat at a healthy rate. Your metabolism is going to gain from garnet's therapeutic properties.

Garnet is as beneficial to spiritual people as any other stone. The darker varieties of Garnet are effective at removing negative energy from the spirit of the wearer. In contrast, the red ones are spirit boosters. Its wearer experiences the spiritual wonders of Garnet, the majority of which are centered on the enhancement of faith and belief in God. Garnet also repels evil spirits and evil beings. The red brilliance that shines like the sun prevents hostile forces from traversing the bearer's soul. Garnet has been widely utilized as a universal spirit guide since ancient times.

tabs.tab2_description:
Although Garnet gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing garnet. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Muladhara or the Root Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for support and stability in life.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses user with grounding and belonging. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Garnet gemstone is recommended for everybody facing health issues, especially those related to the bone structure as it promotes good health and revitalizes the body.

Important Details:

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Garnet gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Garnet gemstones.

 

Garnet Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Garnet is the state mineral of Connecticut and the official gemstone of New York, from which it is also mined in numerous other states in the United States. Additionally, they are found in South Africa, Sri Lanka, India, China, Brazil and Madagascar.

Observe their Color:

The best quality Garnet is clear in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation and tone that is not too dark or light. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Notice their Clarity:

Best quality garnet gemstones have near total clarity with minimum inclusions. A high quality piece of garnet gemstone will have a smooth surface and no inclusions which will be visible to the naked eye.

Examine their Inclusions:

Typical inclusions include solid inclusions, fractures that have healed, liquid inclusions, etc. Demantoid may contain inclusions known as horsetails (chrysotile fibers). Typically, hessonite garnet has an erratic inner appearance and is densely included.

See their Shape:

The majority of garnets are fashioned into standard shapes and calibrated sizes for use in manufactured jewelry.

Check the Carats:

For Garnet of gem quality, the raw Garnet is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Garnet weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Garnet is sold by weight, Garnet prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Garnet has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Garnet:

Due to treatments the Garnet stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated garnets do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Garnet gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Garnet are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Garnet from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Garnet gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

Hold the Garnet in your hand and Chant the Garnet gemstone Mantra:

Preferably, a powerful gemstone such as Garnet should only be worn after consultation with an RRCT specialist. Nevertheless, it will be appropriate if worn according to RRCT, and we will add bhasm and energize it for only positive effects.

You can also give yourself at least 72 hours after embracing a Garnet to determine whether or not you are experiencing any negative effects. If after 72 hours of embracing the Garnet stone you do not feel even the slightest effect, you are safe to use Garnet, as this shows it is safe and sure for you and it will not negatively affect you in any way.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Garnet is a good choice for you. You will soon receive a subtle indication that wealth and good fortune are abundant in your life. Garnet has been considered a gemstone of luck and prosperity for centuries.

How to know if Garnet is working?

Within 10 days of wearing it, you should begin to feel calmer and more grounded, with a more balanced body; these are well-known properties of Garnets of all colors from people all over the world. Garnet, especially dark red Garnet, has a strong grounding effect. During times of upheaval, it provides stability and steadiness.

Assume you are in the midst of making an important decision; the stone will help you get through it. Its calming energy can aid in the resolution of negative emotions such as grief, fear, rage, and even emotional trauma. It brings about peace by dampening negative energy. These are signs that your Garnet is working properly.

How long do the effects of Garnet last?

If cared for properly, a Garnet can be worn as jewelry for generations. You must wear it until your chakras are balanced. Typically, experts advise wearing gemstones for four years, after which they are no longer necessary.
tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Garnet gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Garnet is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).

Color

Color is the most important quality factor for garnet, hence the most clear, vivid and vibrant the best.

Cut

Best quality garnet stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Garnet of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Garnet are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Garnet rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Best quality garnet gemstones have near total clarity with minimum inclusions. A high quality piece of garnet gemstone will have a smooth surface and no inclusions which will be visible to the naked eye.

Dealers deal in garnet stones which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Garnet gemstone Price

The price of Garnet gemstone depends mostly on its color and size.

Garnet gemstone is affordable. You should avoid heated or treated garnets.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Garnet has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Garnet stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Garnet Bracelets at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 150 to INR 1,800 (USD 1.88 to USD 22.50).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Garnet?

The best way to check the authenticity of Garnet is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Garnet are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Garnet carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Garnet is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Garnet have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Garnet, but if you find flaws, then your Garnet is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Garnet are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Garnet. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Garnet, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Garnet from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Garnet. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Garnet. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Garnet Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Garnets are always safe to clean with warm soapy water. The ultrasonic cleaner is generally safe, with the exception of stones with fractures.

Cleaning with steam is not recommended. Rarely, garnets may be treated with fracture filling. Only warm, soapy water should be used to clean stones containing fractures.
